test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In Budget 2022, the Khelo India Scheme, a flagship Central Sector Scheme of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports has been included in which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PM's Awards Scheme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Budget 2022**

 
 
• In Budget 2022, the Khelo India Scheme, a flagship Central Sector Scheme of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports has been included in **PM’s Awards Scheme**.
 
• According to the government, the PM's scheme has been **revamped** with a new approach, with the objective to encourage constructive competition, innovation, replication, and institutionalisation of best practices.
 
• **Civil servants** will now be assessed for the awards for their performance in Poshan Abhiyan, Khelo India, PM SVANidhi scheme, One District One Product Scheme, and seamless end-to-end delivery of services without any human intervention.
 
• Districts will be assessed on whether they made the most of the** Khelo India program** for the development of sports and improving the well-being of citizens and if the scheme percolated down to the grassroots level in promoting physical fitness, identifying budding sports talents, and providing them all necessary support to excel on bigger platforms.
 
• **Awards** will also be given to officers for bringing various innovations in environment conservation, water conservation, energy, education, health, women and child-centric initiatives, sustainable farming, promoting livelihoods, boosting economy, improving governance, ease of doing business, faceless delivery of public services, promoting digital payments and disposal of public grievances.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​**

 
• **The PM’s Awards Scheme**

 
 
• The** PM’s Awards Scheme** seeks to recognize the achievements of the districts towards promoting citizens’ well-being, nurturing the culture of sports, and efforts at bringing in excellence in sports and physical fitness, thereby improving the entire sports eco-system
 
 
 
• **The President's Colour Award**
 
 
• The **President's Colour Award** is the highest honor that can be bestowed upon any military unit in India. It is also known as ′Nishaan′ which is an emblem that all unit officers wear on the left-hand sleeve of their uniform.
 
 
 
• **National Awards Scheme**
 
 
• **National Awards Scheme** is a scheme showcasing appreciation. Also, it acts as positive reinforcement to MSMEs to work hard and attain growth. MSMEs have sustained and have shown tremendous growth in the recent past. 
 
 
 
• **The sports award scheme**
 
 
• **The sports award scheme** is given to sportspersons for "most outstanding performance by a sportsperson" over the period of the last four years.
